children.text: Encryption: This document is accessible only to Experimentation A-rank personnel and the "Collaborator"
January 2, 18:26

Cellular division of the subject in Culture Medium No. 006 has been observed for the first time. As of the time of this data entry, the subject's mass continues to increase. It has been confirmed that Subject A, provided by the "Collaborator," is capable of artificial nurturing. The project has officially entered the research and development phase. The next stage will preliminarily verify Subject A's growth patterns, with the ultimate goal of meeting application standards.
January 7, 8:01

A significant decrease in the activity levels of Subject A and its sectioned tissue (provisionally named Subject B) has been detected. After transferring Subjects A and A1 into mice, the condition was effectively alleviated.

It is estimated that after stabilization, most subjects will remain inactive and will be unable to replicate the functions of █████'s flesh. However, current indicators have not fallen below the project establishment standards, and the controllability of the degraded subjects has been significantly improved, aligning with the project's initial expectations. Experimentation may proceed.

Annotation: After artificial nurturing, █████'s flesh underwent uncontrollable degradation. The "Collaborator" must have employed a rather ingenious method, perhaps even leveraging the power of Paths, to preserve it intact before delivery.

Following continuous electrical stimulation of the subject, a conditional withdrawal reflex was observed in Subject B01. This response was subsequently replicated in later tissue sections taken from the same subject. The subject's sensory capabilities have now met the basic requirements for subsequent cognitive experimentation. The experiment is about to proceed to the next phase.
Annotation: The day we succeed, there will be no more illness in Planarcadia! No one will ever have to suffer and die in a hospital bed like Wynne ever again.
February 7, 17:18

As planned, █████'s flesh was precisely implanted into the █████████ region of the mice's brains. With the exception of Subject 047, all hosts exhibited varying degrees of the "paramount bliss" state, their pain perception was blocked, and their physical capabilities were significantly enhanced.
Annotation: The experimental results deviated somewhat from our initial concept, but Lady Fulwish does not seem displeased.
April 6, 19:09

During the testing process, a subject escaped. It instantaneously transitioned from a state of "paramount bliss" into a state of "rabid." Its flesh and physical functions underwent a mutation within seconds. The escaped individual was recaptured and neutralized on site.

Annotation: The moment Lady Fulwish used the "Happiness Syntax" on the subject, its limbs suddenly began sprouting numerous branches and claws, and it lunged at us. Fortunately, no one was hurt. This is too dangerous. I need to talk to Lady Fulwish.

Additional Annotation: I've been persuaded. How foolish of me to doubt Lady Fulwish, the very "Daughter of Arcadia"? I don't think I've ever been this happy. Let me be the first clinical trial subject... May there be no more suffering in this world.
The experiment has been successfully completed. Preparations are underway to enter the application phase.

Additionally, a method capable of stimulating hosts on a large scale within a short time frame may be required. It is recommended to consider means such as radio waves, magnetic fields, broadcasts, television imagery, or synesthesia beacons.
